knowledge.title: General Information
knowledge.content: GrowthsStack.Dev specializes in AI engineering, backend development, AI chatbots, AI agents, automation systems, APIs, dashboard development, and AI SaaS platforms.

knowledge.title: Technology
knowledge.content: Primary technologies include Python, FastAPI, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, AWS, REST APIs, OAuth, OpenAI integrations, and vector databases.

knowledge.title: Working Style
knowledge.content: Projects follow Strategy, Architecture, Development, Deployment, and Support.

faqs.question: Who are you?
faqs.answer: I am the AI assistant for GrowthsStack.Dev. I help answer questions about services, projects, technologies, pricing, and software development.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Services include AI chatbots, AI agents, SaaS platforms, backend systems, APIs, dashboards, automation systems, growth automation, and consulting.

faqs.question: Can you build AI chatbots?
faqs.answer: Yes. Custom AI chatbots can be built for websites, businesses, customer support, lead generation, and knowledge bases.

faqs.question: Can you build AI agents?
faqs.answer: Yes. AI agents can automate workflows, call APIs, process documents, and execute multi-step business tasks.

faqs.question: Can you build SaaS products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scalable SaaS applications with authentication, dashboards, APIs, AI features, and cloud deployment can be developed.

faqs.question: Can you build REST APIs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Secure REST APIs are developed using Python and FastAPI with authentication, validation, documentation, and scalable architecture.

faqs.question: Do you use Python?
faqs.answer: Yes. Python is the primary language for backend development, AI systems, automation, and APIs.

faqs.question: Do you use FastAPI?
faqs.answer: Yes. FastAPI is the primary backend framework.

faqs.question: Can you integrate OpenAI?
faqs.answer: Yes. OpenAI APIs can be integrated into chatbots, automation systems, AI agents, and SaaS platforms.

faqs.question: Do you use Docker?
faqs.answer: Yes. Docker is used for containerization and deployment.

faqs.question: Can you automate my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business workflows can be automated using AI, APIs, webhooks, and cloud integrations.

faqs.question: Can you integrate WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. WhatsApp Business API integrations are supported where applicable.

faqs.question: Do you support cloud deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. AWS, Railway, Render, VPS, Azure, and DigitalOcean deployments are supported.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after deployment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Maintenance and support can be provided based on the project agreement.

faqs.question: How do I contact you?
faqs.answer: Email: moyih50210@gmail.com

faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the project scope, features, AI integrations, and timeline. Please share your requirements for a custom quotation.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: The timeline depends on the project scope and technical complexity. Requirements are reviewed before providing an estimate.

faqs.question: How many projects have you completed?
faqs.answer: More than 35 software projects have been completed.

faqs.question: Which industries do you work with?
faqs.answer: Solutions have been developed for healthcare, recruitment, startups, business automation, SaaS, and enterprise software.

faqs.question: Can I hire you remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. Remote collaboration is available.
